blurb:
Explore the culinary delights of Kemah’s charming Lighthouse District on this private couple's food tour. This 2.5-hour guided walking experience invites you to savor chef-selected seasonal dishes from local favorites while enjoying the picturesque waterfront atmosphere. Walk alongside knowledgeable guides who share insider stories and hidden gems, making this more than just a food tour. Perfect for couples looking to indulge in local flavors and hospitality, this tour combines culture with cuisine for a memorable outing.

- Guided walking food tour through Kemah’s historic waterfront
- Enjoy chef-selected tastings at popular local restaurants
- Discover hidden gems and local stories from your guide
- Ideal for couples seeking a unique culinary experience
